content:
Zen Garden Pack

Steffen | 2026-03-16 4 items. Calm and mindfulness.

Items (All Rendered)

# Item ID Grid Placement
1 Bamboo Stalks cr-bamboo 1x2 floor
2 Zen Rock Garden cr-rock-garden 2x1 on-desk
3 Meditation Cushion cr-meditation-cushion 1x1 floor
4 Desktop Water Feature cr-water-feature 1x1 on-desk

Design Notes

Bamboo Stalks

Three tall bamboo stalks at different heights in a round stone pot. Green with visible nodes. Gentle sway animation on idle.

Zen Rock Garden

Desktop karesansui with raked sand lines and three smooth stones. Mini bamboo rake included. The stress relief item.

Meditation Cushion

Round zafu cushion in deep purple with pleated sides. Floor placement for character sitting poses. The mindfulness anchor.

Desktop Water Feature

Stacked dark stones with blue water flowing down the levels. LED-lit pool at the base. Water flow animation on idle.

Palette

Color Hex Usage
Bamboo green #4A8A3A Stalks, leaves
Sand #D4C4A0 Rock garden base
Stone #6B6B60 Rocks, pot
Purple #4A2A6A Meditation cushion
Water blue #60A5FA Water feature glow

Renders via Playwright. 128x128 transparent PNGs at 2x device pixel ratio.
